name: Prosciutto, Pear & Blue Cheese Sandwich with Spinach-Mushroom Salad
instructions: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack about 6-inches from the top.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Place oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Thinly slice mushrooms and add to the bowl with the dressing; set aside.
Arrange bread slices on a large baking sheet pan, place in the oven, and broil until toasted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel and thinly slice shallots.
Quarter, core, and thinly slice pears.

Spread mayo and Dijon over half of the toasted bread slices. Layer a small handful of spinach, shallot, pear, prosciutto, and blue cheese over top (reserving remaining spinach for the salad). Close with remaining toast slices.
Add remaining spinach to the bowl with the dressing and mushrooms; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide sandwiches and salad between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
